evidence.quote: On June 7, 1776, Richard Henry Lee of Virginia, introduced this resolution in the Second Continental Congress proposing independence
After fighting broke out in Massachusetts in the spring of 1775
Its second meeting convened in Philadelphia in 1775.
On June 11, 1776, the Congress appointed three concurrent committees in response to the Lee Resolution
New York cast no vote until the newly elected New York Convention upheld the Declaration of Independence on July 9, 1776.
The plan for making treaties was not approved until September of 1776
the plan of confederation was delayed until November of 1777.

objectives: Sequence events from the outbreak of fighting in 1775 through the Lee Resolution and its outcomes in 1776-1777
